sources.name: NOAA Storm Events Database · supplemental reports

method.spatial: positive-area polygon intersection; counties and Oklahoma-clipped ZCTAs; no address or point probability
method.timeUnit: convective day, 12:00 UTC to next 11:59 UTC
method.denominator: Only full calendar years with both UTC source files verified for every convective day; at least two complete years required
method.missing: Absent, failed or invalid daily files are unknown, not zero hail. File availability does not certify radar uptime.
method.uncertainty: Whole observed calendar years resampled at fixed geographic locations; bootstrap sampling bounds, not a comprehensive predictive interval
method.zcta: Exposure uses all Oklahoma portions of a ZCTA. Largest equal-area county overlap is context only, never the exposure assignment.
method.propertyExposure: 1.5+ inches; daily footprint union in EPSG:5070; exact annual spatial-pattern partition; area-weighted, not residentially weighted; no Poisson conversion of county-wide event counts

propertyExposure.locationInterpretation: Uniformly sampled fixed geographic location within the county or Oklahoma-clipped ZCTA; not a typical home or address estimate

1.interpretation: Empirical annual footprint-year resampling; exploratory, not a validated property forecast

5.interpretation: Empirical annual footprint-year resampling; exploratory, not a validated property forecast

10.interpretation: Empirical annual footprint-year resampling; exploratory, not a validated property forecast

propertyExposure.model: Empirical complete-year footprint blocks; exposure evaluated at fixed geographic locations before area aggregation. Years resampled independently with replacement.
propertyExposure.limitations: Only a short observed footprint-year record. Unhit locations are not known to have zero future risk. Year resampling cannot introduce unseen spatial patterns. Bootstrap bounds omit radar, climate and housing-location uncertainty. 5- and 10-year values are exploratory.
